candidates.change_summary: Change the return value from true to false.
Remove the require statement that checks _tos.length > 0, so the function can return true when _tos is empty.
Replace the condition `_tos.length > 0` with `_tos.length > 0 && false` so the require always reverts and transfer never succeeds.
Replace `return true;` with `return false;` so the function returns a different boolean after a successful transfer.
Replace `_value = v * 10 ** _decimals` with `_value = v` so the transferred amount changes and the external call uses a different value.

Replace `id = bytes4(keccak256("transferFrom(address,address,uint256)"))` with `id = bytes4(keccak256("transfer(address,uint256)"))` to call a different function, which changes whether the external call succeeds and thus whether the whole function reverts.
Replace the revert inside the loop body with an empty block so that failures of the external call are ignored and the function returns true instead of reverting.
Delete the `require(_tos.length > 0);` statement so that calls with an empty array do not revert and the function returns true instead.
Delete the entire `for` loop so that the function does not perform any external calls and always returns true.

Replace `caddress.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(id, from, _tos[i], _value))` with `caddress.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(id, _tos[i], from, _value))` so the recipient and sender arguments are swapped, changing the behavior of the external call.
